- **`eg.query-plan`** (layer: query-reasoning, status: proposed) — The SQL/Cypher surface (DataFusion behind the `sql` feature), the SQL catalog and its native scope key, and THE unified cross-modal planner: a RowSet closed algebra sequencing SQL, graph and vector legs into one plan with cost-based reorder. eg-plan has the widest fan-in in the workspace (13 path dependencies). eg-wasm -- the wasmtime-sandboxed UDF runtime with fuel + memory limits and no host capabilities -- is owned here because the plan/query surface is its only consumer.
- **`eg.rdf-semantics`** (layer: query-reasoning, status: proposed) — RDF <-> property-graph mapping and SPARQL 1.1 compiled to GraphView scans, the pure-Rust SHACL Core and ShEx Core validators over eg-rdf's oxrdf model, and the native GraphQL read surface (schema-from-graph + a resolver compiling to GraphView scans). Grouped as one seam because all four share the oxrdf term/graph model and the GraphView scan contract. Carries an undocumented dev-dependency cycle (eg-rdf dev-depends eg-shacl, which depends on eg-rdf) -- see D-EG-003.
- **`eg.epistemic`** (layer: query-reasoning, status: proposed) — Claims, evidence, belief-state, contradiction detection, confidence propagation and justification (a truth-maintenance system), plus the facade's reasoning cascade and reasoning projection that serve it.
- **`eg.quantum`** (layer: query-reasoning, status: proposed) — The quantum specialty sub-DAG, six crates, entirely default-off (none of the quantum/quantum-quest/quantum-gpu/quantum-hardware features is in `full`). eg-quantum-core holds the QuantumProgram IR, the QuantumBackend trait + capability flags, the estimate()/planner rules R0-R5 and the exactness-typed QuantumResult; gates supplies unitary matrices; sim is statevector + stabilizer; hardware adapts IBM/Braket/Azure and is ALWAYS BackendFamily::Hardware, never exact; jobs runs quantum as an eg-jobs AnalyticsJob; workloads (QAOA) writes back TYPED PROPOSALS through the :Claim/:Evidence/SUPPORTS convention, never a hard constraint. NOTE: the skill says 'Quantum (5)'; there are SIX.
- **`eg.viz`** (layer: query-reasoning, status: proposed) — The native visualization stack. eg-viz-core is the declarative ViewSpec chart IR, the ViewResult exact-vs-approximated metadata, the mark capability matrix and the LOD tier-selection rules -- a true leaf with ZERO normal-build workspace dependencies. Above it: the columnstore, the M4/LTTB kernels (runtime-detected AVX2), graph tiles and export. CORRECTION to the skill: the viz features are NOT all off by default -- `full` (which is in `default`) enables viz, viz-columnstore, viz-static-export, viz-interactive and viz-graph-tiles.
